scope: P01 managed synthetic-data-only staging; NOT production or customer use

evidence_levels.VERIFIED_SOURCE: Directly inspected at the pinned main commit or exact-SHA CI response; source/CI proof only
evidence_levels.REPO_REPORTED: Claim present in pinned repository documents but third-party correspondence or human signature was not independently authenticated

owner_approval.finding: P00 owner GO documented. P01 document records owner-signed conditional NO-GO: USD 100/month all-in cap must first be proven. No separate provider, account, region or staging activation approval is established.
owner_approval.requirement_to_clear: Explicit owner selection and bounded approval AFTER acceptable cost enforcement and all pre-provision safeguards are evidenced

provider_region.finding: No P01 provider/account selected or authorized. Railway is rejected for this cap and lacks contractual EU-only commitment according to repo-reported support; AWS new-experience is research only, with Jordan contact address mapping to Stockholm (eu-north-1), not owner-approved.
provider_region.requirement_to_clear: Named provider/account, region, data classification and applicable residency commitments approved by owner; verified eligibility

budget_enforcement.finding: No proven enforceable complete-invoice USD 100 cap. Railway Compute and Agent limits are separate; repository reports continuing storage/backup charges and no guaranteed overrun maximum. AWS new-experience limit applies to pre-tax project costs; taxes, persistent storage, recurring fees, and max overrun for the total invoice remain unresolved. Alerts are not enforcement.
budget_enforcement.requirement_to_clear: Independent provider evidence for enforceable combined monthly invoice <= USD 100 covering compute, agent, database, volumes, backups/PITR, transfer, logs, recurring fees and taxes, with bounded overrun and shutdown costs

identity_oidc.finding: OIDC and JWKS verification code and offline tests exist, but Auth0 is a candidate only. Live issuer, audience, client, trusted metadata, key rotation/revocation and provider-backed identity are not verified.
identity_oidc.requirement_to_clear: Owner-approved real IdP and origin-bound OIDC/JWKS; live valid/invalid/expired JWT and rotation/revocation negative tests on authorized synthetic staging

tenant_isolation.finding: PostgreSQL RLS integrations pass on disposable CI PostgreSQL; local synthetic six-call staging smoke exercises tenant denial. Neither proves the live managed DB runtime role, FORCE RLS, grants, cross-tenant denial or service-registry policy in P01.
tenant_isolation.requirement_to_clear: Approved hosted non-owner/no-BYPASSRLS restricted role; database catalog/grants/FORCE RLS evidence; real negative cross-tenant and denied-write tests with synthetic data

operational_recovery.finding: Source proposes encrypted backups, 7-day retention and RPO/RTO of 24h each; no approved hosted backup, isolated restoration transcript, measured recovery, service-level alerting or rollback evidence for P01 exists in reviewed sources.
operational_recovery.requirement_to_clear: Owner-approved encrypted backup retention and a successful isolated restore rehearsal, measured RPO <= 24h and RTO <= 24h, downtime/runbook/alerting and operator evidence

independent_release_approval.finding: Repository records owner accepting no independent approver for synthetic-only P01 staging; this is not operational P01 GO, does not waive the budget prerequisite, and current P01 decision is signed NO-GO.
independent_release_approval.requirement_to_clear: Fresh documented owner P01 decision on exact evidence and SHA; decide whether documented owner-only release approval is sufficient under policy before any activation

next_owner_decision.question: Authorize a no-account, no-resource, no-spend written clarification request to AWS covering enforceable all-in USD 100/month invoice, excluded charges, overrun bounds and Stockholm residency, or keep AWS unselected and P01 NO-GO?
